payload.comment:
Reporting stage review. No deterministic findings. All arithmetic invariants verified: confusion-matrix row sums match per-class supports (total 7180), macro-averages consistent, selective-risk identity holds (1 − 0.980371 = 0.019629), abstain count (3410) matches 0.47493 × 7180, and total error count (901) reconciles with base accuracy. Test lock enforced (test_metrics_used=false in search). Training history is internally consistent (best_epoch 13, patience 3, halted at 15). Search completed 8/8 trials with no failures.

Key warnings carried into the report:
1. Validation-to-test accuracy gap of 12.1 pp (0.9958 → 0.8745) indicates the selection signal overestimated generalization; the report should prominently flag this.
2. Abstention coverage drops from 80.0 % (validation) to 52.5 % (test), a 27.5 pp gap; the operational coverage guarantee does not transfer to the test distribution.
3. OOD evaluation is limited to controlled Gaussian-noise corruption (σ 0.15/0.25/0.4); real-world domain shift, novel tissue types, and imaging artefacts are unverified. Validation AUROC 0.995 vs test AUROC ~0.89 mirrors the generalization gap.
4. Class-level concerns on test: cancer-associated stroma recall 45.6 %, smooth muscle F1 0.632, adipose→smooth-muscle confusion 21 % of adipose samples. These were not visible at validation level.
5. Minor documentation/reproducibility items: rotate90 augmentation (discrete 90°) vs recommended small-angle jitter; early_stopping_patience=3 below recommended 5–8; normalization label 'standardize' lacks explicit per-channel qualifier; transformer-specific parameters present in residual_cnn config (likely shared-schema no-ops, unconfirmed).

None of these are deterministic failures; they are generalization and documentation risks that the final report must surface transparently. Action: revise the report to (a) state the val→test gap and its implications explicitly, (b) qualify the OOD claim as a controlled-corruption proxy only, (c) highlight the two weak classes, and (d) add a reproducibility appendix covering the minor config items.
llm_issues: Validation-to-test accuracy gap of 12.1 pp (0.9958 → 0.8745) not prominently flagged in report
Abstention coverage guarantee does not transfer: 80.0 % validation → 52.5 % test (27.5 pp gap)
OOD evaluation limited to Gaussian-noise corruption; real-world domain shift unverified
Cancer-associated stroma recall 45.6 % and smooth muscle F1 0.632 on test; not visible in validation metrics
Adipose→smooth-muscle confusion (283/1338 = 21 %) is the single largest error source on test
Augmentation 'rotate90' (90° discrete) deviates from recommended small-angle jitter; under-documented
early_stopping_patience=3 below recommended 5–8; low risk but limited margin
Normalization labeled 'standardize' without explicit per-channel qualifier
Transformer-specific parameters present in residual_cnn config; likely no-ops but unconfirmed
